name: tokenshield
displayName: TokenShield — AI Token & Cost Optimizer (Copilot & Claude)
description: Save 60–90% AI token & LLM costs across GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex. Zero-latency context pruning, AST skeletons, semantic cache, and real-time savings tracking.

tokenshield.enabled.description: Enable or disable all token optimizations.

tokenshield.autoApply.description: Automatically apply token optimization directives when opening a workspace.

tokenshield.targetTools.description: Which AI tools to generate instruction files for.

tokenshield.profile.description: Active optimization profile. Profiles control which strategies are enabled.
enumDescriptions: All 19 strategies active — maximum enterprise token & cost savings
Disables output compression and diff-only for full log & test diagnostics
Disables verbosity restrictions and guardrails for deep architectural reviews
Preserves full context history for thorough code reviews
Use custom strategy combination from activeStrategies setting

outputCompression.description: RTK terminal and test output compression

sessionManagement.description: Context compaction and multi-turn session pruning

semanticCache.description: Local semantic cache (zero model tokens for repeated questions)

astSkeleton.description: AST type skeleton extraction (~90% smaller file context)

contextExclusion.description: Smart context exclusions (auto-exclude lockfiles, dist/, minified code)

diffOnlyOutput.description: Diff-only output format (~92% output token savings)

agentGuardrails.description: Loop guardrails (prevents expensive runaway retry cycles)

smartModelRouting.description: Smart model routing (suggests lighter models for routine edits)

gitDiffContext.description: Git diff scoping (restricts reviews to git diff + 1-hop callers/callees)

kvCacheAlignment.description: Prompt prefix caching (maintains byte-aligned prefixes for cloud KV caches)

commentStripper.description: Comment and header stripper (removes copyright preambles on ingestion)

testFailureIsolator.description: Test failure isolator (extracts failing assertions and line numbers only)

rangeSlicing.description: Windowed range slicing (restricts file reads to 100-line windows around symbols)

inlineChatScopePinning.description: Inline chat scope lock (constrains inline chat to selected lines + references)

copilotIgnoreGeneration.description: .copilotignore generator (blocks build outputs, lockfiles, and secrets)

copilotEditsAwareness.description: Edit session awareness (avoids re-reading files already in active editor session)

threadResetTrigger.description: Context saturation monitor (suggests fresh thread when conversation exceeds 40 messages)

tokenshield.activeStrategies.description: Toggle individual optimization features (used when profile is 'custom').

tokenshield.verbosityLevel.description: Verbosity reduction level: Light (~20%), Full (~35%), Ultra (~50%).

tokenshield.preserveExistingInstructions.description: Preserve existing user content in instruction files when updating.

tokenshield.autoInstallTools.description: Automatically check and install supporting CLI tools.

tokenshield.configureMcpOnActivation.description: Automatically configure MCP servers (token-cache, Context7, CodeGraph) on activation.

tokenshield.pricing.description: Model pricing table in USD per 1M tokens (used for savings dashboard calculations).

maxRetries.description: Max retry attempts before pausing for user confirmation

maxFilesPerTask.description: Max files to modify in one task before asking confirmation

maxFileReads.description: Max reads of the same file in a single conversation

tokenshield.guardrails.description: Agent loop guardrail limits to prevent runaway tool usage.

tokenshield.useVscodeStorage.description: Store instructions cleanly in .vscode/copilot-instructions.md instead of modifying public git tracking. Use 'Export to Repository' command when team-wide repo commit is desired.

tokenshield.githubInstructions.description: Write instructions to .github/ (the path VS Code Copilot auto-discovers). Recommended: true. Set false only if you prefer to keep all generated files out of git.

tokenshield.githubStructureMode.description: How TokenShield integrates with .github/: 'auto' detects structured layout (.github/instructions/), 'flat' writes directly to .github/copilot-instructions.md, 'structured' writes to .github/instructions/tokenshield.instructions.md.

tokenshield.generateAgentFiles.description: Scaffold TokenShield agent (.github/agents/tokenshield.agent.md) and optimization skill (.github/skills/tokenshield-optimize/SKILL.md) in structured .github repositories.

tokenshield.telemetry.enabled.description: Enable 100% on-device token and cost savings tracking.
